# Iron Body by Artemis

> > Iron Body by Artemis (Goddess Fit) offers online fitness programs including Summer Shred v.2.0, bodyweight training circuits, and business coaching for fitness entrepreneurs.

This site combines fitness programming with business mentorship, featuring workout routines, training programs, promotional sales, and entrepreneurial success stories from the creator's journey scaling an online fitness business.
